A '''mission''' to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was undertaken by the crew of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] during [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], his wife [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and their allies sought to rescue the fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Vima-Da-Boda]]. Meanwhile, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Zasm Katth]] and [[Baddon Fass]], commanding the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Imperial-class)|''Invincible'']] were on a mission of their own on the moon. The two [[darksider]]s had orders from their leader, [[Sedriss QL]], to recruit the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and then locate the ''Millennium Falcon'' and kill Vima-Da-Boda.<ref name="DE II" />

Fett refused to cooperate with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and struck out on his own in an attempt to capture Solo. Fass and Katth were killed when the ''Invincible'' collided with a traffic control pylon operated by [[Mako Spince]]. Solo and his allies successfully retrieved Vima-Da-Boda and escaped<ref name="DE II" /> only to be pursued by Fett, forcing them to take shelter on [[Ganath/Legends|Ganath]].<ref name="DE II 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref>
